correctness.rationale: Reduction R_8 to R_4 is a homomorphism with right-annihilator kernel. For R_4, direct coefficient equations give only zero and the two affine two-space idempotent families. A char-2 symbolic coefficient expansion of every lift proves h=0, t(t+1)=0, and equality of two free coordinates, leaving exactly four affine three-space fibers. Translation handles the odd class. A standalone Python standard-library checker verifies eight formal polynomial identities over GF(2) and exhaustively enumerates full GF(2) and GF(4) idempotent sets (33 and 257). The infinite claim follows from the symbolic proof, not the finite tests.

value.rationale: A complete set-theoretic classification for a natural noncommutative eight-element dihedral quandle algebra, uniform over all characteristic-two fields, gives four disjoint affine three-spaces plus isolated zero. The projection obstruction is sharper than merely counting: among two nonzero affine two-space quotient families, only four basis idempotents lift, each along a three-dimensional affine fiber. This concrete failure of automatic lifting in a canonical quandle covering motivates further idempotent and automorphism study and is not a textbook substitution or an arbitrary computer slice.
